raw_sections.Description:
The Lenovo LOQ 15IRX9 gaming laptop combines an Intel Core™ i7-13645HX, 14C (6P + 8E) / 20T, P-core up to 4.9GHz, E-core up to 3.5GHz, 24MB Intel® Smart Cache processor, NVIDIA GeForce RTX™ 4050 6GB GDDR6, Boost Clock 2370MHz, TGP 105W, 194 AI TOPS graphics, and a 15.6" FHD (1920x1080) IPS 300nits Anti-glare, 100% sRGB, 144Hz, G-SYNC® display for gaming in Egypt through Compumarts.
Key specs


CPU
Intel Core™ i7-13645HX, 14C (6P + 8E) / 20T, P-core up to 4.9GHz, E-core up to 3.5GHz, 24MB Intel® Smart Cache

NVIDIA GeForce RTX™ 4050 6GB GDDR6, Boost Clock 2370MHz, TGP 105W, 194 AI TOPS

512GB SSD M.2 2242 PCIe® 4.0x4 NVMe®


DISPLAY
15.6" FHD (1920x1080) IPS 300nits Anti-glare, 100% sRGB, 144Hz, G-SYNC®


WEIGHT
Starting at 2.38 kg (5.25 lbs)
